findings.text: both armed suite blocks (baseline_suite and after_suite) state their command as the prose placeholder <twelve promotion test files plus tests/test_lane_advisory_on_dispatch.py> rather than the command that actually ran; the real thirteen-file command vector is on the second line of the log each block names, so the figures are traceable but the manifest alone cannot be re-run verbatim, and writing the actual vector would remove the hazard at no cost.

item_verdicts.diff: satisfied: the production change is the conditional carry at promotion.py:3814-3818 -- skip a key the pointer did not carry, copy when it did -- and that is precisely the mechanism the absent-key clause requires; the 239 added test lines synthesise a temporary ledger repository with its own RECKON_HOME so the promotion runs against a repo the test owns, and every assertion reads the promoted row off disk; the subjects are conventional and both docs commit bodies state why the plan HTML was edited directly and that the section is left for the coordinator.
item_verdicts.done_when: satisfied: every clause of the evidence fence holds on the delivered record and each is traceable to a log on disk. The row-carries-the-advisory case reads the promoted row off disk, never the pointer the promotion consumed (tests/test_lane_advisory_on_dispatch.py:572, row produced by _committed_row at :563); the taken-vs-declined pair is two promotions distinguished from their committed rows alone (:593); the no-advisory run asserts the key is absent while declaration and reading are present, so the absence belongs to the advisory rather than to a record that was never written (:620); the promotion set was measured in one pass with both figures recorded, base 5ebc9f28 at 4 failed / 153 passed against head 33779328 at 4 failed / 156 passed with identical failing ids and zero head-only failures, and both logs' first lines name the resolved revision and the tree they ran in (logs/base.log:1, logs/head.log:1); and the declared control was applied to a scratch git-archive copy of the fixed tree, where the row-carries-the-advisory case was observed to redden with KeyError: 'lane_advisory' at tests/test_lane_advisory_on_dispatch.py:583, the red log's first line repeating the declared mutation verbatim and in full (logs/negative_control_lane_advisory_row.log:1).
item_verdicts.goal: satisfied: the deliverable carries the lane advisory across the promotion boundary as the goal states, and the mechanism is bounded to exactly that: a conditional carry at reckon/crew/promotion.py:3814-3818 copies lane_advisory, lane_declaration and lane_reading from the pointer record onto the committed row, each key written only when the pointer carried it, so a promoted run's committed ledger row holds what its live pointer held while a run whose dispatch never emitted an advisory promotes with the key absent rather than a null that would read as an assessed-and-quiet lane.
item_verdicts.manifest: complete with one shape defect. Claims I re-checked reproduce: the base and head figures and their four failing ids against the two logs, the gate's 15 passed at debba812 against logs/gate-final.log, the mutation string against the red log's first line verbatim, and the orientation base sha 5ebc9f28a393c367ee0331f46c3976e9916896ca, forty characters and resolvable, agreeing with the plan landing record. The defect this review records: both armed suite blocks state their command as a prose placeholder rather than the command that ran, so the actual thirteen-file vector is recoverable only from the second line of the log each block names.
item_verdicts.write_paths: satisfied at reading level: the three commits 33779328, 17401e4d, debba812 and the manifest's changed_paths name exactly the five declared scopes and nothing else -- reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_lane_advisory_on_dispatch.py, the plan section, the cumulative evidence record and the figure directory -- the two docs commits are insert-only appends and the plan section is deliberately left open for the coordinator; the worktree is clean at the reviewed head.

justifications.durability: the change is additive and permanent in the two places a later reader asks -- the committed ledger row and the test that asserts it -- and the conditional write preserves the distinction the plan's design rests on (an absent advisory is absence, not a null assessment); the record that outlives its writer carries a resolvable forty-character orientation base sha and three conventional commits with rationale in their bodies, so nothing in the record is a fuse that fires later.
justifications.evidence: the package is strong and self-locating: both suite logs name resolved revisions and their trees in the first line (base 5ebc9f28, head 33779328, no symbolic revision hazard), the base was a git-archive copy measured in the same pass, the failure ids are identical across the two runs with the pass count rising by exactly the three new cases (153 to 156), the declared control reddens the named case for the named reason with the declared sentence verbatim on its first line and the mutation named on its third, against one deduction: the armed suite blocks in the manifest state their command as a prose placeholder rather than the command that ran (manifest.md:13-14), so re-running that measurement from the manifest alone is impossible and the reader must open the log's second line.
justifications.fit: the carry sits where the record-to-row copies already sit in the promotion's completion path, reuses the established Mapping-guarded copy idiom, is fenced to the node that designed it, and its tests exercise the entry point a promotion actually enters with a repository the test owns rather than the shared checkout.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal is met exactly and at the level that matters: the committed row, which is what survives promotion and what a later reader asks, now carries the advisory together with the lane declaration and reading it was derived from, and backend on the row is what tells taking the advice apart from declining it; an advisory-less run's row carries no advisory key, so absence of advice is not misread as an assessment that found the lane quiet.
justifications.scope_discipline: the change lands inside the fence and nowhere else: the five declared paths are the paths changed, the two docs commits are insert-only appends to this node's own plan section and to the cumulative evidence record, no other plan, index or sprint state is touched, the section is deliberately not closed by the worker as the contract requires, and no plan, sprint or ticket identifier enters the code change, the test names or the figure's path.
